data.name: Revolution: Young Mao
data.detailed_description:
【About This Game】

This project is a historical visual novel focusing on the revolutionary history of the late 1920s. Told through a first-person perspective, the game transports players back to the turbulent era around 1929. You will follow in the protagonist's footsteps, reliving the epic story of the early Red Army as they forged a path through immense hardships and dangers. Through meticulously researched interactive text, the game aims to provide players with an immersive, deeply engaging historical experience.

【Gameplay & Features】

  • Immersive Interactive Reading Experience The game utilizes a classic visual novel format to drive the narrative forward. Players progress through the story by clicking to read, experiencing the historical weight and deep character emotions woven between the lines, accompanied by evocative illustrations and text presentations.

  • First-Person Historical Perspective Abandoning the detachment of a bystander's view, players will dive deep into the inner world of the protagonist. The game not only showcases grand historical events but also emphasizes the thoughts and feelings of characters within their specific historical contexts, allowing you to directly feel the idealism and passion of that era.

  • Crucial Narrative Choices At major turning points that shaped history, the game offers specific branching choices for player interaction. Although the wheels of history roll forward and the main storyline follows historical facts, your choices at critical moments will trigger unique dialogue feedback and situational details. Facing certain life-or-death decisions, a wrong choice may trigger a crisis and immediately end the current run (returning you to the main menu). Players must think carefully and make the correct decisions aligned with historical context.

  • Pure Narrative Focus The game contains no tedious, complex action mechanics or stat-grinding systems, focusing 100% of its core on "storytelling." It is ideal for players who love historical themes, biographical stories, and prefer experiencing deep narrative value through reading.
